title: EVERY BELT ITEM SHOWS AN INFO CARD
why: His order of 2026-10-12: other items on the tactical belt should show an info card too. Rest the mouse on any item key (a heal, a plate, a stim, ammo, a grenade, the Tripwire Mine, a key) and its card shows above the key, in the frame and type of the gun card: the name and a bar in its rarity colour, the rarity and how many you hold, what it does in numbers (heals and up to what, armour, rounds, damage, blast and fuse, how long a smoke or a decoy lasts, what sets the Tripwire Mine off), its value in credits, and its keys as keycaps. Short caps labels, no sentences. Like the gun card it waits a short moment, goes the moment the mouse leaves and never gets in the way of the trigger.
now: Rest the mouse on any item on the tactical belt and its info card shows above it.

edits.replacement:
S=hotbarSlots()[c.i]; g=beltHovGun(S);
  if(!g) return beltInfoCard(S,c);   // v24.xx (belthover2): every other item shows its info card
